A '''magnetic hoist''' was a [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] device used in [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] to move cargo. One was used in the [[Senatorial Palace/Legends|Senatorial Palace]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].
